schemaNotes: Single source of truth for account-deletion data classification. Every user-keyed write destination across src/ and functions/ must appear here in either included[] or excluded[]. The drift-prevention test (src/lib/__tests__/accountDeletionDrift.test.ts) scans the codebase and fails if any detected user-keyed write is unclassified. Counts are enforced by EXPECTED_INCLUDED_COUNT / EXPECTED_EXCLUDED_COUNT in src/lib/__tests__/accountDeletionCounts.test.ts — changing inventory size requires a deliberate constant edit. CI must mark these tests as required checks.

strategies.deleteSubcollection: Iterate the subcollection in batches and delete every doc
strategies.deleteQueryInBatches: Run a where() query and batch-delete results until empty
strategies.deleteCollectionGroupInBatches: collectionGroup() across the project, filtered by stored uid field + segment-aware pathFilter, batch-delete
strategies.anonymiseAndOverwriteContent: Update doc to clear user-identifying fields AND replace user-visible content with a tombstone string (e.g. 'Comment deleted'); preserve original server-side fields only when explicitly justified
strategies.anonymiseAuthorOnly: Update doc to clear authorId/displayName/photoURL only; user-visible content stays. Used when content has thread-continuity value AND contains no PII (kudos counts, etc.)
strategies.anonymiseMinimisedShape: Strip the doc to a minimised retention shape — drop screenshots, profile links, comment snippets, route context; retain only fields required for the stated retention purpose

lockTypes.direct-rules: Firestore rules deny client writes while accountDeletionRequests/{uid}.status is active
lockTypes.callable-actor: Cloud Function callable rejects writes when context.auth.uid has active deletion (entry check)
lockTypes.referenced-uid: Cloud Function callable creating cross-user references rejects when any referenced uid has active deletion (transactional check at write commit)
lockTypes.system-writer: Background/scheduled/webhook function checks deletedAccounts tombstone immediately before each write (NOT only at function entry — long-running jobs must check per-uid at commit time)
lockTypes.none: No lock needed (e.g. read-only, write happens during deletion itself, or the path is operational)

designConstants.executionOrder: Phase A acquire deletion lease/status lock in small transaction · Phase B activate write-freeze (rules + storage custom claim) · Phase C preflight collect content IDs and edge lists AFTER lock is active · Phase D clean cross-user mirrors and content-ID references · Phase E anonymise / minimise UGC records · Phase F delete user-owned subcollections (in dependency order: mirrors before originals, content-ID refs before content) · Phase G delete users/{uid}/public subcollection · Phase H delete users/{uid} root LAST · Phase I verify cleanup (sampled for high-volume paths, exact for low-volume) · Phase J transition status to completed in transaction that re-checks operationId + leaseGeneration + zero pendingCleanupShards
designConstants.verificationRule: Firestore reads/queries are strongly consistent after committed writes — direct path reads and collectionGroup queries verify immediately. Retries are warranted ONLY for: BulkWriter/recursiveDelete promises not fully awaited, time-budgeted cleanup leaving pendingCleanupShards, Storage propagation, async Firestore/Storage triggers, transient ABORTED/UNAVAILABLE errors, stale-lease takeover. Do NOT mask deterministic missed paths with arbitrary sleeps.
designConstants.systemWriterCheckTiming: Scheduled and batch system writers MUST check isTombstoned(uid) immediately before each write commit, not only at function entry. Reason: weeklyPerformanceRollup reads active users, computes for seconds-to-minutes, then writes — between read and write a user may have started deletion.
designConstants.counterIdempotence: Counter decrements (memberCount, participantCount, kudosCount) MUST run in a transaction that (1) reads the membership/participant/kudos doc, (2) if it exists, deletes it and decrements; (3) if it does not exist (retry), does NOT decrement. Counter clamped at 0 server-side. Retry-safe by construction.
designConstants.lockFirstEnumerateSecond: Do NOT enumerate large user data inside the lease transaction. Acquire lease (small txn), activate write-freeze, then enumerate (activity IDs, run IDs, workout IDs, public share IDs, crew IDs, challenge IDs, follow edge IDs) OUTSIDE the transaction. Use that post-lock enumeration as the preflight list for content-ID reference cleanup.

minimisedShape.abuseIdentityHashSpec: DESIGN ONLY — implementation requires server-side HMAC secret in Firebase Functions config (functions.config().moderation.hmac_secret). Setting the secret is a manual setup checklist item; if absent, executor falls back to anonymiseAuthorOnly with full targetId removal (no re-registration detection).
